AS BIGINT) ORDER BY f.anchor_sequence, f.symbol, f.confirmation_sequence","parameter":"run","shape":"rows"},"/trades":{"sql":"SELECT 'paper' AS execution, * FROM symmtables.symm.paper_round_trips_v2 ORDER BY closed DESC, symbol","shape":"rows"},"/hindsight/metric-map":{"sql":"WITH document AS (SELECT content FROM read_text('manifest/system.json')), vocabulary AS (SELECT content FROM read_text('manifest/cut.json')), coordinates AS (SELECT split_part(json_extract_string(identity.value, '$'), ':', 1) AS source, split_part(json_extract_string(identity.value, '$'), ':', 2) AS metric, json_extract_string(identity.value, '$') AS identity, 'gather.values' || CASE WHEN identity.key = '0' THEN '' ELSE '_' || identity.key END AS destination FROM vocabulary, json_each(vocabulary.content, '$.nodes.gather.inputData.identities.value') AS identity), metrics AS (SELECT source, metric, identity, string_agg(destination, ', ' ORDER BY destination) AS destinations FROM coordinates GROUP BY source, metric, identity) SELECT (SELECT sha256(document.content || vocabulary.content) FROM document CROSS JOIN vocabulary) AS graphDigest, (SELECT json_group_object(identity, json_object('identity', identity, 'source', source, 'metric', metric, 'destinations', destinations)) FROM metrics) AS metrics, (SELECT json_group_object(source, json_object('source', source)) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT source FROM coordinates)) AS signals","shape":"object"}}
